notes: CBSA's update-account service (UPDACC) on GENERATED Db2 rows (#4507), proving the cbsa-updacc port on data it was not written against: 30 IBMUSER.ACCOUNT rows built from CRETB01's CREATE TABLE and CREI101's unique index (sort code + account number unique together) -- each column's boundaries (CHAR at full length and blank, DECIMAL(12,2) at +/-9999999999.99 and +/-0.01, INTEGER at 2147483647 and -2147483648, DATE 0001-01-01 / 9999-12-31 / 2024-02-29) and a NULL in every nullable column, then values in between; a quarter under another sort code. 40 generated LINKs: the account number each row's in turn (a fifth of the time one they do not hold: SELECT +100), the account type valid, blank or starting with a space, overdraft and rate at their PICTUREs' edges. A NULL date, eyecatcher or rate reaches the SELECT's -305 (no indicator variables); an INTEGER overdraft beyond S9(9) COMP its -304. Every task's statements are compared with what Db2 answered (compare_sql), and the table after every task, column by column.
